Pre-cached follower names. The 8B's own name sampling is low-entropy -- across separate playthroughs it returns the same handful (Grug, Kalthok, Zx'thal), which is what this file exists to fix. The service RESERVES a name from here when a follower is created and the prompt tells the model which name to use, the same division of labour boons and the spy crack already use: the server picks the concrete detail, the model only phrases it. A name that is actually revealed in play is written to name_history.json and will not be handed out again until it ages out, so consecutive runs do not repeat.

Lookup: pool = races[race] UNION groups[group of race], falling back to default. The union is deliberate -- a short race pool still gets depth, and a new (DLC) race with no entry of its own still draws something that fits its kind instead of falling through to a generic default. Group membership comes from comprehension.json.

Writing more: names must survive extract_name, i.e. match [A-Z][a-zA-Z'-]+ (letters, apostrophes and hyphens only -- NO digits, so 'Unit-7' is impossible and 'Cog-Seven' is fine), optionally two such words, 2-40 chars, and must not collide with NAME_REJECTS. `python3 service.py --names` validates every entry by round-tripping it through the real extractor. Do NOT add canon names (Merlin, Herx, Lilith, Bram, Gharbad, Algernon, Arthur, Shelob, Baphomet) -- a follower must never inherit a named character's identity.
